prs.title: Add HTML sanitizer for translated message resources

review_comments.body:
logic error in anchor validation - when anchors match, it replaces the English anchor text in the translated value string, which corrupts the value. The function should either strip anchors from both strings for comparison separately, or just validate without modifying the value.

Current flow:
1. Find `<a href="X">` in value (translated)
2. Find `<a href="X">` in englishValue
3. If they match → replace englishValue's anchor IN the value string (wrong!)

This causes the translated string to have English anchor text removed instead of the translated anchor.
